(lemma position_unprocessed
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
    (and (<= k position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (not (processed order k (idx order position))))
  (body
    (if
      (processed order k (idx order position))
      (block
        (obtain ((earlier int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 earlier) (< earlier k))
            (== (idx order earlier) (idx order position))))
        (assert (== earlier position))
        (assert false))
      (block))))

(lemma unprocessed_position
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (not (processed order k v)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= k i) (< i n))
        (== (idx order i) v))))
  (body
    (call permutation_position order n v)
    (obtain ((position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
        (== (idx order position) v)))
    (if
      (< position k)
      (block
        (assert (processed order k v))
        (assert false))
      (assert
        (and
          (and (<= k position) (< position n))
          (== (idx order position) v))))))

(lemma swap_value_range
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx after position))
      (< (idx after position) n)))
  (body
    (ghost-let source int (swap_index position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source) (< source n)))
    (assert (== (idx after position) (idx before source)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx after position))
        (< (idx after position) n)))))

(lemma swap_position
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
        (== (idx after position) v))))
  (body
    (call permutation_position before n v)
    (obtain ((old_position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 old_position) (< old_position n))
        (== (idx before old_position) v)))
    (ghost-let new_position int (swap_index old_position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 new_position) (< new_position n)))
    (assert (== (swap_index new_position i j) old_position))
    (assert (== (idx after new_position) v))
    (assert
      (exists ((position int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (== (idx after position) v))))))

(lemma swap_unique
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (== (idx after a) (idx after b)))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let source_a int (swap_index a i j))
    (ghost-let source_b int (swap_index b i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_a) (< source_a n)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_b) (< source_b n)))
    (assert (== (idx before source_a) (idx before source_b)))
    (assert (== source_a source_b))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_a i j) a))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_b i j) b))
    (assert (== a b))))

(lemma swap_permutation
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j))
  (ensures (permutation after n))
  (body
    (forall ((position int))
      (call swap_value_range before after n i j position))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call swap_position before after n i j v))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call swap_unique before after n i j a b))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx after position))
            (< (idx after position) n)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
          (exists ((position int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
              (== (idx after position) v))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=>
            (== (idx after a) (idx after b))
            (== a b)))))
    (assert (permutation after n))))

(lemma selection_advance
  (params
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (scan int)
    (old_best int) (new_best int) (choose bool)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (selection_state
      order k scan old_best known_values dist_values)
    (< scan (len order))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order scan))
      (< (idx order scan) (len known_values)))
    (==
      choose
      (and
        (idx known_values (idx order scan))
        (or
          (not (idx known_values (idx order old_best)))
          (<
            (idx dist_values (idx order scan))
            (idx dist_values (idx order old_best))))))
    (== new_best (if choose scan old_best)))
  (ensures
    (selection_state
      order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= k new_best)
        (< new_best (+ scan 1))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx order new_best))
        (< (idx order new_best) (len known_values))))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= k position) (< position (+ scan 1)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx order position))
              (< (idx order position) (len known_values)))
            (=>
              (idx known_values (idx order position))
              (and
                (idx known_values (idx order new_best))
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values (idx order new_best))
                  (idx dist_values (idx order position)))))))))
    (assert
      (selection_state
        order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))))

(lemma relaxed_progress_zero
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (chosen int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (size graph_value)))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (relaxed_state
      graph_value order k known_values dist_values))
  (ensures
    (relaxed_progress
      graph_value order k chosen 0 known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert
      (relaxed_progress
        graph_value order k chosen 0 known_values dist_values))))

(lemma weight_search
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (vertex int) (edge_weight int) (target int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i target))
    (== (get (idx row target) 0) vertex)
    (== (get (idx row target) 1) edge_weight)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= i j) (< j target))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) vertex))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
  (decreases (- target i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i target)
      (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) vertex))
        (call weight_search
          row vertex edge_weight target (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))))))

(lemma edge_weight_exact
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (u int) (v int) (edge_weight int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (has_edge (view graph_value) u v edge_weight))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view graph_value) u v) edge_weight))
  (body
    (obtain ((target int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph_value))))
          (and
            (<= 0 target)
            (< target (len (idx (view graph_value) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 1)
              edge_weight))))
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j target))
          (!= (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) j) 0) v))))
    (call weight_search
      (idx (view graph_value) u) v edge_weight target 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view graph_value) u v) edge_weight))))

(lemma singleton_route
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start_vertex int))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path g start_vertex start_vertex
      (seq-lit start_vertex))
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start_vertex)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start_vertex)
    (assert
      (reachable_path g start_vertex start_vertex
        (seq-lit start_vertex)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start_vertex)) 0))))

(lemma route_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start_vertex int) (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (reachable_path g start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path
      g start_vertex
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (connected
      g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      end_vertex))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (reachable_path
        g start_vertex
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) end_vertex))))

(lemma path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma route_extend
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (start_vertex int) (u int) (v int) (edge_weight int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (reachable_path (view graph_value) start_vertex u p)
    (has_edge (view graph_value) u v edge_weight))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex v
      (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight
        (view graph_value)
        (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view graph_value) p) edge_weight)))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_exact graph_value u v edge_weight)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view graph_value)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (reachable_path
        (view graph_value) start_vertex v
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view graph_value)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view graph_value) p) edge_weight)))))

(lemma frontier_path
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
    (== (len order) (size graph_value))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (and (<= 0 end_vertex) (< end_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k end_vertex)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== end_vertex start_vertex))
        (assert (== (path_weight (view graph_value) p) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 frontier)
                  (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let previous int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph_value) previous end_vertex edge_weight))
        (call edge_weight_exact
          graph_value previous end_vertex edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 previous)
                    (< previous (len (view graph_value))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 edge_index)
                    (< edge_index
                      (len (idx (view graph_value) previous)))))
                (and
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      0)
                    end_vertex)
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      1)
                    edge_weight))))
            (assert (idx known_values end_vertex))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (+ (idx dist_values previous) edge_weight)))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block
            (call frontier_path
              graph_value start_vertex order k
              known_values dist_values previous prefix)
            (obtain ((frontier int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 frontier)
                    (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                  (not (processed order k frontier)))
                (and
                  (idx known_values frontier)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values frontier)
                    (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values frontier)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier_result int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier_result)
                      (< frontier_result (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier_result)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier_result)
                    (<=

   (order (seq int)) (k int)
   (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  bool
  (requires
    (and
      (well_formed graph_value)
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
        (and
          (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
          (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph_value)))
            (and
              (<= 0 i)
              (< i (len (idx (field graph_value adj) u)))))
          (and
            (processed order k u)
            (idx known_values u)))
        (and
          (idx known_values
            (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
          (<=
            (idx dist_values
              (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
            (+
              (idx dist_values u)
              (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxed_progress
  ((graph_value weighted_graph)
   (order (seq int)) (k int) (chosen int) (limit int)
   (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  bool
  (requires
    (and
      (well_formed graph_value)
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (size graph_value)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 limit)
              (<= limit (len (idx (field graph_value adj) chosen))))
            (and
              (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
              (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))))))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph_value)))
            (and
              (<= 0 i)
              (< i (len (idx (field graph_value adj) u)))))
          (and
            (or
              (processed order k u)
              (and (== u chosen) (< i limit)))
            (idx known_values u)))
        (and
          (idx known_values
            (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
          (<=
            (idx dist_values
              (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
            (+
              (idx dist_values u)
              (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn selection_state
  ((order (seq int)) (k int) (scan_limit int) (best_position int)
   (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  bool
  (requires
    (and
      (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
      (and
        (and (< k scan_limit) (<= scan_limit (len order)))
        (and
          (== (len known_values) (len order))
          (== (len dist_values) (len order))))))
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= k best_position) (< best_position scan_limit))
      (and
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx order best_position))
          (< (idx order best_position) (len known_values)))
        (forall ((j int))
          (=>
            (and (<= k j) (< j scan_limit))
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx order j))
                (< (idx order j) (len known_values)))
              (=>
                (idx known_values (idx order j))
                (and
                  (idx known_values (idx order best_position))
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))
                    (idx dist_values (idx order j))))))))))))

(ghost-fn swap_index ((position int) (i int) (j int)) int
  (body
    (if
      (== position i)
      j
      (if (== position j) i position))))

(ghost-fn is_swap
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (n int) (i int) (j int))
  bool
  (requires
    (and
      (and (== (len before) n) (== (len after) n))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)))))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
        (==
          (idx after k)
          (idx before (swap_index k i j)))))))

(lemma identity_permutation
  (params (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (permutation (identity_order n) n))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (identity_order n)) n))
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
          (== (idx (identity_order n) i) i))))
    (assert (permutation (identity_order n) n))))

(lemma permutation_position
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
        (== (idx order i) v))))
  (body
    (assert
      (exists ((i int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
          (== (idx order i) v))))))

(lemma permutation_value
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order position))
      (< (idx order position) n)))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx order position))
        (< (idx order position) n)))))

(lemma position_unprocessed
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
    (and (<= k position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (not (processed order k (idx order position))))
  (body
    (if
      (processed order k (idx order position))
      (block
        (obtain ((earlier int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 earlier) (< earlier k))
            (== (idx order earlier) (idx order position))))
        (assert (== earlier position))
        (assert false))
      (block))))

(lemma unprocessed_position
  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (not (processed order k v)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int))
      (and
        (and (<= k i) (< i n))
        (== (idx order i) v))))
  (body
    (call permutation_position order n v)
    (obtain ((position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
        (== (idx order position) v)))
    (if
      (< position k)
      (block
        (assert (processed order k v))
        (assert false))
      (assert
        (and
          (and (<= k position) (< position n))
          (== (idx order position) v))))))

(lemma swap_value_range
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx after position))
      (< (idx after position) n)))
  (body
    (ghost-let source int (swap_index position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source) (< source n)))
    (assert (== (idx after position) (idx before source)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx after position))
        (< (idx after position) n)))))

(lemma swap_position
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
        (== (idx after position) v))))
  (body
    (call permutation_position before n v)
    (obtain ((old_position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 old_position) (< old_position n))
        (== (idx before old_position) v)))
    (ghost-let new_position int (swap_index old_position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 new_position) (< new_position n)))
    (assert (== (swap_index new_position i j) old_position))
    (assert (== (idx after new_position) v))
    (assert
      (exists ((position int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (== (idx after position) v))))))

(lemma swap_unique
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (== (idx after a) (idx after b)))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let source_a int (swap_index a i j))
    (ghost-let source_b int (swap_index b i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_a) (< source_a n)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_b) (< source_b n)))
    (assert (== (idx before source_a) (idx before source_b)))
    (assert (== source_a source_b))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_a i j) a))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_b i j) b))
    (assert (== a b))))

(lemma swap_permutation
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j))
  (ensures (permutation after n))
  (body
    (forall ((position int))
      (call swap_value_range before after n i j position))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call swap_position before after n i j v))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call swap_unique before after n i j a b))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx after position))
            (< (idx after position) n)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
          (exists ((position int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
              (== (idx after position) v))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=>
            (== (idx after a) (idx after b))
            (== a b)))))
    (assert (permutation after n))))

(lemma selection_advance
  (params
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (scan int)
    (old_best int) (new_best int) (choose bool)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (selection_state
      order k scan old_best known_values dist_values)
    (< scan (len order))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order scan))
      (< (idx order scan) (len known_values)))
    (==
      choose
      (and
        (idx known_values (idx order scan))
        (or
          (not (idx known_values (idx order old_best)))
          (<
            (idx dist_values (idx order scan))
            (idx dist_values (idx order old_best))))))
    (== new_best (if choose scan old_best)))
  (ensures
    (selection_state
      order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= k new_best)
        (< new_best (+ scan 1))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx order new_best))
        (< (idx order new_best) (len known_values))))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= k position) (< position (+ scan 1)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx order position))
              (< (idx order position) (len known_values)))
            (=>
              (idx known_values (idx order position))
              (and
                (idx known_values (idx order new_best))
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values (idx order new_best))
                  (idx dist_values (idx order position)))))))))
    (assert
      (selection_state
        order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))))

(lemma relaxed_progress_zero
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (chosen int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (size graph_value)))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (relaxed_state
      graph_value order k known_values dist_values))
  (ensures
    (relaxed_progress
      graph_value order k chosen 0 known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert
      (relaxed_progress
        graph_value order k chosen 0 known_values dist_values))))

(lemma weight_search
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (vertex int) (edge_weight int) (target int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i target))
    (== (get (idx row target) 0) vertex)
    (== (get (idx row target) 1) edge_weight)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= i j) (< j target))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) vertex))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
  (decreases (- target i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i target)
      (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) vertex))
        (call weight_search
          row vertex edge_weight target (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))))))

(lemma edge_weight_exact
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (u int) (v int) (edge_weight int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (has_edge (view graph_value) u v edge_weight))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view graph_value) u v) edge_weight))
  (body
    (obtain ((target int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph_value))))
          (and
            (<= 0 target)
            (< target (len (idx (view graph_value) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 1)
              edge_weight))))
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j target))
          (!= (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) j) 0) v))))
    (call weight_search
      (idx (view graph_value) u) v edge_weight target 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view graph_value) u v) edge_weight))))

(lemma singleton_route
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start_vertex int))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path g start_vertex start_vertex
      (seq-lit start_vertex))
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start_vertex)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start_vertex)
    (assert
      (reachable_path g start_vertex start_vertex
        (seq-lit start_vertex)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start_vertex)) 0))))

(lemma route_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start_vertex int) (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (reachable_path g start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path
      g start_vertex
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (connected
      g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      end_vertex))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (reachable_path
        g start_vertex
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) end_vertex))))

(lemma path_weight_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma route_extend
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (start_vertex int) (u int) (v int) (edge_weight int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (reachable_path (view graph_value) start_vertex u p)
    (has_edge (view graph_value) u v edge_weight))
  (ensures
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex v
      (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight
        (view graph_value)
        (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view graph_value) p) edge_weight)))
  (body
    (call edge_weight_exact graph_value u v edge_weight)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view graph_value)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (reachable_path
        (view graph_value) start_vertex v
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view graph_value)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view graph_value) p) edge_weight)))))

(lemma frontier_path
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
    (== (len order) (size graph_value))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (and (<= 0 end_vertex) (< end_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k end_vertex)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== end_vertex start_vertex))
        (assert (== (path_weight (view graph_value) p) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 frontier)
                  (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let previous int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph_value) previous end_vertex edge_weight))
        (call edge_weight_exact
          graph_value previous end_vertex edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 previous)
                    (< previous (len (view graph_value))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 edge_index)
                    (< edge_index
                      (len (idx (view graph_value) previous)))))
                (and
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      0)
                    end_vertex)
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      1)
                    edge_weight))))
            (assert (idx known_values end_vertex))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (+ (idx dist_values previous) edge_weight)))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block
            (call frontier_path
              graph_value start_vertex order k
              known_values dist_values previous prefix)
            (obtain ((frontier int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 frontier)
                    (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                  (not (processed order k frontier)))
                (and
                  (idx known_values frontier)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values frontier)
                    (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values frontier)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier_result int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier_result)
                      (< frontier_result (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier_result)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier_result)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier_result)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))))))))

(lemma chosen_path_lower
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (best_position int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (>= (size graph_value) 0)
    (permutation order (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (size graph_value)))
    (and (<= k best_position) (< best_position (size graph_value)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order best_position))
      (< (idx order best_position) (size graph_value)))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (selection_state
      order k (size graph_value) best_position
      known_values dist_values)
    (not
      (processed order k (idx order best_position)))
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value)
      start_vertex
      (idx order best_position)
      p))
  (ensures
    (>=
      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)
      (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))))

  (ensures

          (not (processed order k frontier)))

  (decreases (len p))

      (block

        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and

                  (<= 0 frontier)

                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block

        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)

        (call edge_weight_exact

        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))

                (idx dist_values end_vertex)

            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))

                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block

                (and

            (assert

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let max_edge i64 100000)
    (assert (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 100000)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dist_i) 0)))
    (let-mut known (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (known_i) false)))
    (let-mut order (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (order_i) order_i)))
    (call identity_permutation n)
    (assert (== order (identity_order n)))
    (assert (permutation order n))
    (set-idx known start true)
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (call singleton_route (view graph) start)
    (let-mut steps i64 0)
    (while (< steps n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 100000)))
      (invariant (permutation order n))
      (invariant (== (len order) n))
      (invariant (== (len known) n))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 steps) (<= steps n)))
      (invariant (idx known start))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant
        (known_witnesses graph start known dist))
      (invariant
        (settled_state graph start order steps known dist))
      (invariant
        (relaxed_state graph order steps known dist))
      (invariant
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
              (idx known v))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx dist v))
              (<= (idx dist v) (* steps max_edge))))))
      (decreases (- n steps))
      (let-mut best_position i64 steps)
      (call permutation_value order n best_position)
      (let-mut scan i64 (+ steps 1))
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant (and (< steps scan) (<= scan n)))
        (invariant
          (selection_state
            order steps scan best_position known dist))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (call permutation_value order n scan)
        (let scan_vertex i64 (idx order scan))
        (let choose_best bool
          (and
            (idx known scan_vertex)
            (or
              (not (idx known (idx order best_position)))
              (<
                (idx dist scan_vertex)
                (idx dist (idx order best_position))))))
        (ghost-let previous_best i64 best_position)
        (if choose_best
          (set best_position scan)
          (block))
        (assert
          (==
            best_position
            (if choose_best scan previous_best)))
        (call selection_advance
          order steps scan previous_best best_position choose_best
          known dist)
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (call permutation_value order n best_position)
      (call position_unprocessed order n steps best_position)
      (let chosen_vertex i64 (idx order best_position))
      (if
        (idx known chosen_vertex)
        (call chosen_shortest
          graph start order steps best_position known dist)
        (call chosen_unreachable
          graph start order steps best_position known dist))
      (assert
        (if
          (idx known chosen_vertex)
          (is_shortest_dist
            (view graph) start chosen_vertex
            (idx dist chosen_vertex))
          (no_route (view graph) start chosen_vertex)))
      (ghost-let old_order (seq int) order)
      (let first_vertex i64 (idx order steps))
      (set-idx order steps chosen_vertex)
      (set-idx order best_position first_vertex)
      (assert
        (is_swap old_order order n steps best_position))
      (call swap_permutation
        old_order order n steps best_position)
      (assert (permutation order n))
      (assert
        (== (idx order steps) chosen_vertex))
      (assert
        (== (take order steps) (take old_order steps)))
      (assert
        (==
          (take order (+ steps 1))
          (concat
            (take old_order steps)
            (seq-lit chosen_vertex))))
      (assert
        (settled_state
          graph start order (+ steps 1) known dist))
      (if
        (idx known chosen_vertex)
        (block
          (let row_len i64
            (len (idx (field graph adj) chosen_vertex)))
          (call relaxed_progress_zero
            graph order steps chosen_vertex known dist)
          (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
          (while (< edge_i row_len)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i row_len)))
            (invariant (permutation order n))
            (invariant (== (len known) n))
            (invariant (== (len dist) n))
            (invariant (idx known chosen_vertex))
            (invariant
              (known_witnesses graph start known dist))
            (invariant
              (settled_state
                graph start order (+ steps 1) known dist))
            (invariant
              (relaxed_progress
                graph order steps chosen_vertex edge_i
                known dist))
            (invariant
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                    (idx known v))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx dist v))
                    (<=
                      (idx dist v)
                      (* (+ steps 1) max_edge))))))
            (decreases (- row_len edge_i))
            (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
              (idx
                (idx (field graph adj) chosen_vertex)
                edge_i))
            (let to i64 (get edge 0))
            (let weight i64 (get edge 1))
            (assert
              (has_edge
                (view graph) chosen_vertex to weight))
            (assert (and (<= 0 to) (< to n)))
            (assert (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight max_edge)))
            (call candidate_route
              graph start known dist
              chosen_vertex to weight)
            (assert
              (in_i64
                (+ (idx dist chosen_vertex) weight)))
            (let candidate i64
              (+ (idx dist chosen_vertex) weight))
            (assert (>= candidate 0))
            (assert
              (<= candidate (* (+ steps 1) max_edge)))
            (call processed_no_improve
              graph start order (+ steps 1)
              known dist to candidate)
            (if
              (or
                (not (idx known to))
                (< candidate (idx dist to)))
              (block
                (assert
                  (not (processed order (+ steps 1) to)))
                (assert (!= to chosen_vertex))
                (ghost-let pre_dist (seq int) dist)
                (ghost-let pre_known (seq bool) known)
                (set-idx dist to candidate)
                (set-idx known to true)
                (assert
                  (forall ((position int))
                    (=>
                      (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
                      (==
                        (idx known position)
                        (if
                          (== position to)
                          true
                          (idx pre_known position))))))
                (assert
                  (forall ((position int))
                    (=>
                      (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
                      (==
                        (idx dist position)
                        (if
                          (== position to)
                          candidate
                          (idx pre_dist position))))))
                (assert
                  (known_witnesses graph start known dist))
                (assert
                  (settled_state
                    graph start order (+ steps 1)
                    known dist))
                (assert
                  (relaxed_progress
                    graph order steps chosen_vertex edge_i
                    known dist)))
              (block))
            (assert
              (relaxed_progress
                graph order steps chosen_vertex (+ edge_i 1)
                known dist))
            (assert
              (forall ((v int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                    (idx known v))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx dist v))
                    (<=
                      (idx dist v)
                      (* (+ steps 1) max_edge))))))
            (set edge_i (+ edge_i 1)))
          (assert
            (relaxed_state
              graph order (+ steps 1) known dist)))
        (assert
          (relaxed_state
            graph order (+ steps 1) known dist)))
      (assert
        (known_witnesses graph start known dist))
      (assert
        (settled_state
          graph start order (+ steps 1) known dist))
      (assert
        (relaxed_state
          graph order (+ steps 1) known dist))
      (assert
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
              (idx known v))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx dist v))

(lemma swap_permutation
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j))
  (ensures (permutation after n))
  (body
    (forall ((position int))
      (call swap_value_range before after n i j position))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call swap_position before after n i j v))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call swap_unique before after n i j a b))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx after position))
            (< (idx after position) n)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
          (exists ((position int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
              (== (idx after position) v))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=>
            (== (idx after a) (idx after b))
            (== a b)))))
    (assert (permutation after n))))

(lemma selection_advance

  (requires

      order k scan old_best known_values dist_values)

      (<= 0 (idx order scan))
      (< (idx order scan) (len known_values)))
    (==
      choose
      (and
        (idx known_values (idx order scan))
        (or
          (not (idx known_values (idx order old_best)))
          (<
            (idx dist_values (idx order scan))
            (idx dist_values (idx order old_best))))))
    (== new_best (if choose scan old_best)))
  (ensures
    (selection_state
      order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= k new_best)
        (< new_best (+ scan 1))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx order new_best))
        (< (idx order new_best) (len known_values))))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= k position) (< position (+ scan 1)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx order position))
              (< (idx order position) (len known_values)))
            (=>
              (idx known_values (idx order position))
              (and
                (idx known_values (idx order new_best))
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values (idx order new_best))
                  (idx dist_values (idx order position)))))))))
    (assert
      (selection_state
        order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))))

(lemma frontier_path
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
    (== (len order) (size graph_value))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (and (<= 0 end_vertex) (< end_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k end_vertex)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== end_vertex start_vertex))
        (assert (== (path_weight (view graph_value) p) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 frontier)
                  (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let previous int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph_value) previous end_vertex edge_weight))
        (call edge_weight_exact
          graph_value previous end_vertex edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 previous)
                    (< previous (len (view graph_value))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 edge_index)
                    (< edge_index
                      (len (idx (view graph_value) previous)))))
                (and
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      0)
                    end_vertex)
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      1)
                    edge_weight))))
            (assert (idx known_values end_vertex))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (+ (idx dist_values previous) edge_weight)))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block
            (call frontier_path
              graph_value start_vertex order k
              known_values dist_values previous prefix)
            (obtain ((frontier int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 frontier)
                    (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                  (not (processed order k frontier)))
                (and
                  (idx known_values frontier)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values frontier)
                    (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values frontier)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier_result int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier_result)
                      (< frontier_result (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier_result)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier_result)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier_result)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))))))))

(lemma weight_search
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (vertex int) (edge_weight int) (target int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i target))
    (== (get (idx row target) 0) vertex)
    (== (get (idx row target) 1) edge_weight)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= i j) (< j target))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) vertex))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
  (decreases (- target i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i target)
      (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) vertex))
        (call weight_search
          row vertex edge_weight target (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))))))

(lemma edge_weight_exact
  (params

        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph_value))))
          (and
            (<= 0 target)
            (< target (len (idx (view graph_value) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 0) v)

    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j target))

(lemma route_prefix
  (params

    (start_vertex int) (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))

        (take p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma frontier_path
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
    (== (len order) (size graph_value))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (and (<= 0 end_vertex) (< end_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k end_vertex)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== end_vertex start_vertex))
        (assert (== (path_weight (view graph_value) p) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 frontier)
                  (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let previous int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph_value) previous end_vertex edge_weight))
        (call edge_weight_exact
          graph_value previous end_vertex edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 previous)
                    (< previous (len (view graph_value))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 edge_index)
                    (< edge_index
                      (len (idx (view graph_value) previous)))))
                (and
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      0)
                    end_vertex)
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      1)
                    edge_weight))))
            (assert (idx known_values end_vertex))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (+ (idx dist_values previous) edge_weight)))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block
            (call frontier_path
              graph_value start_vertex order k
              known_values dist_values previous prefix)
            (obtain ((frontier int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 frontier)
                    (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                  (not (processed order k frontier)))
                (and
                  (idx known_values frontier)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values frontier)
                    (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values frontier)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier_result int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier_result)
                      (< frontier_result (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier_result)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier_result)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier_result)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))))))))

(lemma relax_update_progress
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (chosen int) (limit int)
    (old_known (seq bool)) (old_dist (seq int))
    (new_known (seq bool)) (new_dist (seq int))
    (target int) (candidate int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (size graph_value)))
    (and
      (<= 0 limit)
      (<= limit (len (idx (field graph_value adj) chosen))))
    (== (len old_known) (size graph_value))
    (== (len old_dist) (size graph_value))
    (== (len new_known) (size graph_value))
    (== (len new_dist) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 target) (< target (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k target))
    (!= target chosen)
    (relaxed_progress
      graph_value order k chosen limit old_known old_dist)
    (or
      (not (idx old_known target))
      (< candidate (idx old_dist target)))
    (forall ((position int))
      (=>
        (and
          (<= 0 position)
          (< position (size graph_value)))
        (==
          (idx new_known position)
          (if
            (== position target)
            true
            (idx old_known position)))))
    (forall ((position int))
      (=>
        (and
          (<= 0 position)
          (< position (size graph_value)))
        (==
          (idx new_dist position)
          (if
            (== position target)
            candidate
            (idx old_dist position))))))
  (ensures
    (relaxed_progress
      graph_value order k chosen limit new_known new_dist))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (i int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph_value)))
              (and
                (<= 0 i)
                (< i (len (idx (field graph_value adj) u)))))
            (and
              (or
                (processed order k u)
                (and (== u chosen) (< i limit)))
              (idx new_known u)))
          (and
            (idx new_known
              (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
            (<=
              (idx new_dist
                (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 0))
              (+
                (idx new_dist u)
                (get (idx (idx (field graph_value adj) u) i) 1)))))))
    (assert
      (relaxed_progress
        graph_value order k chosen limit new_known new_dist))))

(lemma result_entry
  (params

    (match (idx output v)
      (case (none)

          (=>

                (== (idx p 0) start_vertex)

      (case (some d)

          (view graph_value) start_vertex v d))))

  (params (order (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation order n)
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n))
    (and (<= k position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (not (processed order k (idx order position))))
  (body
    (if
      (processed order k (idx order position))
      (block
        (obtain ((earlier int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 earlier) (< earlier k))
            (== (idx order earlier) (idx order position))))
        (assert (== earlier position))
        (assert false))
      (block))))

(lemma unprocessed_position

(lemma swap_value_range
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (position int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position n)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx after position))
      (< (idx after position) n)))
  (body
    (ghost-let source int (swap_index position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source) (< source n)))
    (assert (== (idx after position) (idx before source)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx after position))
        (< (idx after position) n)))))

(lemma swap_position
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
        (== (idx after position) v))))
  (body
    (call permutation_position before n v)
    (obtain ((old_position int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 old_position) (< old_position n))
        (== (idx before old_position) v)))
    (ghost-let new_position int (swap_index old_position i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 new_position) (< new_position n)))
    (assert (== (swap_index new_position i j) old_position))
    (assert (== (idx after new_position) v))
    (assert
      (exists ((position int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position n))
          (== (idx after position) v))))))

(lemma swap_unique
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
    (== (idx after a) (idx after b)))
  (ensures (== a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let source_a int (swap_index a i j))
    (ghost-let source_b int (swap_index b i j))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_a) (< source_a n)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 source_b) (< source_b n)))
    (assert (== (idx before source_a) (idx before source_b)))
    (assert (== source_a source_b))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_a i j) a))
    (assert (== (swap_index source_b i j) b))
    (assert (== a b))))

(lemma swap_ranges
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))

  (requires

(lemma swap_positions
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))

  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))

    (is_swap before after n i j))

(lemma swap_uniqueness
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j))
  (ensures
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
          (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (=>
          (== (idx after a) (idx after b))
          (== a b)))))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call swap_unique before after n i j a b))

      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>

            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))

(lemma swap_permutation
  (params
    (before (seq int)) (after (seq int))
    (n int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (permutation before n)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j n))
    (== (len after) n)
    (is_swap before after n i j))
  (ensures (permutation after n))
  (body
    (call swap_ranges before after n i j)
    (call swap_positions before after n i j)
    (call swap_uniqueness before after n i j)

(lemma selection_advance
  (params
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (scan int)
    (old_best int) (new_best int) (choose bool)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len order)))
    (and (< k scan) (< scan (len order)))
    (== (len known_values) (len order))
    (== (len dist_values) (len order))
    (selection_state
      order k scan old_best known_values dist_values)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order scan))
      (< (idx order scan) (len known_values)))
    (==
      choose
      (and
        (idx known_values (idx order scan))
        (or
          (not (idx known_values (idx order old_best)))
          (<
            (idx dist_values (idx order scan))
            (idx dist_values (idx order old_best))))))
    (== new_best (if choose scan old_best)))
  (ensures
    (selection_state
      order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))
  (body
    (assert (<= (+ scan 1) (len order)))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= k new_best)
        (< new_best (+ scan 1))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 new_best)
        (< new_best (len order))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx order new_best))
        (< (idx order new_best) (len known_values))))
    (assert
      (forall ((position int))
        (=>
          (and (<= k position) (< position (+ scan 1)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 position)
              (< position (len order)))
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx order position))
                (< (idx order position) (len known_values)))
              (=>
                (idx known_values (idx order position))
                (and
                  (idx known_values (idx order new_best))
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values (idx order new_best))
                    (idx dist_values (idx order position))))))))))
    (assert
      (selection_state
        order k (+ scan 1) new_best known_values dist_values))))

(lemma weight_search
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (vertex int) (edge_weight int) (target int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 target) (< target (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i target))
    (== (get (idx row target) 0) vertex)
    (== (get (idx row target) 1) edge_weight)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= i j) (< j target))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) vertex))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
  (decreases (- target i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i target)
      (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) vertex))
        (call weight_search
          row vertex edge_weight target (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row vertex i) edge_weight))))))

(lemma edge_weight_exact
  (params

  (body
    (obtain ((target int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph_value))))
          (and
            (<= 0 target)
            (< target (len (idx (view graph_value) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) target) 1)
              edge_weight))))
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j target))
          (!= (get (idx (idx (view graph_value) u) j) 0) v))))
    (call weight_search
      (idx (view graph_value) u) v edge_weight target 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view graph_value) u v) edge_weight))))

(lemma singleton_route

(lemma route_prefix
  (params

  (body

(lemma route_extend
  (params
