(lemma frontier_path
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (end_vertex int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len order)))
    (== (len order) (size graph_value))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
    (and (<= 0 end_vertex) (< end_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (not (processed order k end_vertex)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== end_vertex start_vertex))
        (assert (== (path_weight (view graph_value) p) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((frontier int))
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 frontier)
                  (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                (not (processed order k frontier)))
              (and
                (idx known_values frontier)
                (<=
                  (idx dist_values frontier)
                  (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let previous int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call route_prefix
          (view graph_value) start_vertex end_vertex p)
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph_value) previous end_vertex edge_weight))
        (call edge_weight_exact
          graph_value previous end_vertex edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (call path_weight_step (view graph_value) p)
        (if
          (processed order k previous)
          (block
            (assert (idx known_values previous))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values previous)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))
            (obtain ((edge_index int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 previous)
                    (< previous (len (view graph_value))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 edge_index)
                    (< edge_index
                      (len (idx (view graph_value) previous)))))
                (and
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      0)
                    end_vertex)
                  (==
                    (get
                      (idx
                        (idx (view graph_value) previous)
                        edge_index)
                      1)
                    edge_weight))))
            (assert (idx known_values end_vertex))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (+ (idx dist_values previous) edge_weight)))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values end_vertex)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier)
                      (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))))
          (block
            (call frontier_path
              graph_value start_vertex order k
              known_values dist_values previous prefix)
            (obtain ((frontier int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (<= 0 frontier)
                    (< frontier (size graph_value)))
                  (not (processed order k frontier)))
                (and
                  (idx known_values frontier)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist_values frontier)
                    (path_weight (view graph_value) prefix)))))
            (assert
              (<=
                (idx dist_values frontier)
                (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))
            (assert
              (exists ((frontier_result int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (<= 0 frontier_result)
                      (< frontier_result (size graph_value)))
                    (not (processed order k frontier_result)))
                  (and
                    (idx known_values frontier_result)
                    (<=
                      (idx dist_values frontier_result)
                      (path_weight (view graph_value) p))))))))))))

(lemma chosen_path_lower
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (best_position int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (>= (size graph_value) 0)
    (permutation order (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (size graph_value)))
    (and (<= k best_position) (< best_position (size graph_value)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order best_position))
      (< (idx order best_position) (size graph_value)))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (selection_state
      order k (size graph_value) best_position
      known_values dist_values)
    (not
      (processed order k (idx order best_position)))
    (reachable_path
      (view graph_value)
      start_vertex
      (idx order best_position)
      p))
  (ensures
    (>=
      (path_weight (view graph_value) p)
      (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))))
  (body
    (call frontier_path
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values
      (idx order best_position) p)
    (obtain ((frontier int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 frontier) (< frontier (size graph_value)))
          (not (processed order k frontier)))
        (and
          (idx known_values frontier)
          (<=
            (idx dist_values frontier)
            (path_weight (view graph_value) p)))))
    (call unprocessed_position
      order (size graph_value) k frontier)
    (obtain ((frontier_position int))
      (and
        (and
          (<= k frontier_position)
          (< frontier_position (size graph_value)))
        (== (idx order frontier_position) frontier)))
    (assert
      (<=
        (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))
        (idx dist_values frontier)))
    (assert
      (>=
        (path_weight (view graph_value) p)
        (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))))))

(lemma chosen_shortest
  (params
    (graph_value weighted_graph) (start_vertex int)
    (order (seq int)) (k int) (best_position int)
    (known_values (seq bool)) (dist_values (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph_value)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph_value))
    (>= (size graph_value) 0)
    (permutation order (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (size graph_value)))
    (and (<= k best_position) (< best_position (size graph_value)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx order best_position))
      (< (idx order best_position) (size graph_value)))
    (== (len known_values) (size graph_value))
    (== (len dist_values) (size graph_value))
    (and (<= 0 start_vertex) (< start_vertex (size graph_value)))
    (idx known_values start_vertex)
    (== (idx dist_values start_vertex) 0)
    (known_witnesses
      graph_value start_vertex known_values dist_values)
    (settled_state
      graph_value start_vertex order k known_values dist_values)
    (relaxed_state graph_value order k known_values dist_values)
    (selection_state
      order k (size graph_value) best_position
      known_values dist_values)
    (idx known_values (idx order best_position)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist
      (view graph_value)
      start_vertex
      (idx order best_position)
      (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))))
  (body
    (call position_unprocessed
      order (size graph_value) k best_position)
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (reachable_path
          (view graph_value)

    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist
        (view graph_value)

        (idx order best_position)
        (idx dist_values (idx order best_position))))))

(lemma chosen_no_route_path
